attributes.title: AI Engineer
attributes.description:
• TypeScript: experiencia sólida desarrollando software listo para producción.
  • Agentes de IA y sistemas multiagente: experiencia práctica construyendo y orquestando sistemas basados en LLM en producción, incluyendo roles, coordinación, transferencia entre agentes, uso de herramientas, memoria y gestión de contexto.
  • Frameworks y proveedores de IA: experiencia con Vercel AI SDK e integración de distintos proveedores de LLM, con criterio para seleccionar las herramientas y modelos adecuados.
  • Arquitectura e integración de sistemas: experiencia integrando APIs, bases de datos y código existente, incluyendo implementación de RAG.
  • Streaming y baja latencia: experiencia desarrollando aplicaciones de IA en tiempo real o con respuestas en streaming.
  • Evaluación y calidad de IA: experiencia creando datasets de prueba, sistemas de scoring y pruebas de regresión para evaluar la calidad y confiabilidad de los agentes.
  • Observabilidad y depuración: experiencia con tracing, logs estructurados y monitoreo de coste, latencia y calidad de las respuestas.
  • Seguridad en sistemas de IA: conocimiento de riesgos y medidas de protección para aplicaciones basadas en agentes autónomos.
attributes.projects:
Vixiees está desarrollando una plataforma de producción en la que los agentes de IA forman parte de la infraestructura central del producto. La plataforma utiliza sistemas multiagente para gestionar flujos de trabajo dirigidos a clientes y procesos internos.

Position Information: El AI Engineer será responsable de diseñar, desarrollar, integrar y mantener agentes de inteligencia artificial en producción, asegurando su fiabilidad, calidad, observabilidad y capacidad de escalar. Trabajará con agentes conversacionales de texto, WhatsApp y voz, así como con agentes que analizan dashboards y datos de negocio.
attributes.functions:
• Diseñar y desarrollar sistemas de orquestación multiagente, definiendo roles, herramientas, memoria y lógica de transferencia entre agentes.
  • Contribuir al desarrollo de agentes de voz y llamadas, optimizando el streaming, la latencia y la fluidez de las conversaciones en tiempo real.
  • Gestionar el ciclo de vida completo de las funcionalidades de IA: diseño de prompts y arquitectura, integración con APIs y fuentes de datos, pruebas, despliegue y monitorización.
  • Desarrollar y mantener pipelines de evaluación de IA, incluyendo datasets, sistemas de puntuación automatizada y evaluaciones mediante LLM-as-a-judge.
  • Implementar mecanismos de observabilidad mediante logs estructurados, trazabilidad de decisiones y llamadas a herramientas, y métricas de coste, latencia y precisión.
  • Depurar y resolver problemas de comportamiento de agentes en producción a través de canales conversacionales.
  • Mejorar la fiabilidad y seguridad de los agentes, incorporando controles para sistemas autónomos que ejecutan acciones y toman decisiones.
  • Colaborar con los equipos de producto e ingeniería para integrar los agentes en los flujos de trabajo existentes sin afectar la aplicación principal.

attributes.title: Staff Data Scientist / Machine Learning Engineer
attributes.description:
- Hands-on experience in Machine Learning Engineering using Python, including developing, deploying, and maintaining production-grade ML models, for 5+ years.

- Proven experience with gradient boosting algorithms (XGBoost, CatBoost, or LightGBM), including hyperparameter tuning, feature importance analysis, and advanced model evaluation.

- Strong proficiency in SQL and BigQuery, including complex feature engineering queries, scheduled data transformations, and data validation.

- Hands-on experience deploying and maintaining ML workloads on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including Cloud Run, Airflow/Composer, Vertex AI, and Pub/Sub.

- Solid understanding of model calibration, business-oriented loss functions, and the impact of prediction errors on downstream optimization systems.

- Practical experience integrating ML model outputs with external systems through APIs, such as advertising platforms, recommendation engines, pricing systems, or bidding systems. Strongly preferred:

- Experience in e-commerce or Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) environments, particularly customer lifetime value (LTV) prediction, purchase forecasting, churn modeling, or customer segmentation.

- Familiarity with probabilistic customer models (BG/NBD, Gamma-Gamma, or similar frameworks) or strong foundations in Bayesian statistics.

- Experience with advertising platform integrations, including Google Ads API (ConversionUploadService, Enhanced Conversions), Meta Conversions API (CAPI), or similar server-side event tracking systems.

- Knowledge of identity resolution and entity matching techniques, including graph-based identity stitching, probabilistic matching, or cross-device identity resolution.

- Level of English – from Upper-Intermediate and above.
attributes.projects:
Andersen is hiring a Staff Data Scientist / Machine Learning Engineer for a project developing an AI-powered advertising platform to predict customer lifetime value and optimize campaign performance.

The customer is a technology company that develops software solutions to help businesses improve operational efficiency and make data-driven decisions. The company leverages modern technologies, including artificial intelligence and data analytics, to optimize business processes, enhance performance, and support sustainable business growth.

The project is focused on developing and enhancing an AI-powered advertising optimization platform that predicts customer lifetime value using machine learning models. It integrates predictive value signals with major advertising platforms to improve value-based bidding, optimize marketing budgets, and maximize campaign performance through accurate data calibration and automated signal delivery.
attributes.functions:
- Building and maintaining predictive Lifetime Value (pLTV) models using XGBoost, CatBoost, and BG/NBD within a tiered scoring architecture, routing users into appropriate model tiers based on data availability and observability rather than applying a one-size-fits-all regression approach.

- Designing, implementing, and maintaining model calibration layers to transform raw predictions into platform-ready values, incorporating haircut scalars, linear, logarithmic, and rank-based normalization, and asymmetric loss functions that penalize overestimating low-value customers more heavily than underestimating high-value customers.

- Owning feature engineering processes in BigQuery, developing and maintaining Gold-layer feature tables from cleaned Silver-layer data, including RFM metrics, behavioral embeddings, category affinity, and purchase velocity.

- Ensuring feature quality and reliability by evaluating data completeness, monitoring missing-value rates, and excluding features with high missing rates among new users rather than relying on imputation.

- Monitoring model drift and distribution shifts, implementing residual logging, comparing pre- and post-signal deployment cohorts, and identifying causal contamination in retraining datasets resulting from the model's influence on user acquisition.

- Maintaining and improving batch Union-Find identity resolution algorithms in BigQuery, connecting GA4 behavioral identifiers with Shopify transactional identifiers and optimizing identity match rates to improve signal quality.

- Developing and maintaining production-grade Python applications running on Google Cloud Run Jobs, orchestrating workflows through Apache Airflow, and ensuring reliable delivery of ML-generated signals to advertising platforms.

- Implementing and maintaining automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, idempotent processing, and dry-run safety mechanisms to ensure production stability, prevent costly errors, and protect client advertising performance.

attributes.title: Senior AI / Full-Stack Engineer
attributes.description:
• Background in B2B SaaS or product-led companies.
  • 5+ years of full-stack development experience, with strong fluency in either TypeScript/Node or Python (ideally both) and a modern frontend framework (React, Next.js, or Angular).
  • Hands-on agent work: tool or function calling, multi-step orchestration, retrieval, structured output, evals, guardrails, and managing cost and latency.
  • Production-level use of AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, etc.). You have shipped LLM features to paying B2B customers.
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD, containerization (Docker), and at least one major cloud (GCP, AWS, or Azure). Solid grasp of DevOps fundamentals: IaC, monitoring, logging, alerting.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where priorities shift and you're expected to own outcomes.
  • Very strong written English (C1 or C2). We write things down.
  • You work well as a peer on a team of senior engineers: you review their code, and they review yours.
attributes.projects:
Common Forge has been developing custom software for over 20 years. Today, we are on a mission to support construction & trade companies by leveraging advanced technologies to enhance their project planning and talent development processes.

We are hiring a senior engineer who ships product features end-to-end and brings genuine fluency with AI development tooling. The majority of your time will be building the features users see, while you will also spend time making our engineering team faster, more reliable, and more leveraged through AI-augmented workflows. If you have built with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, etc. and can point to concrete output that proves it, let's talk.

We are looking for a team member who has shipped LLM-based agents to customers in a B2B SaaS product. You code with AI assistants every day and know what a modern CI/CD pipeline looks like. Construction experience is a plus. This is not an ML research or model-training role.
attributes.functions:
• Own features end to end: the React and Next.js front end, the TypeScript APIs, Postgres, and the deploy. Must have strong PR hygiene.
  • Design, build and ship LLM agents and features in our product: tool calling over our APIs and data, multi-step workflows, retrieval and structured output.
  • Build the evals, guardrails and logging that prove those features work, and keep the cost and latency of each model call in check.
  • Turn vague problems from contractors (project managers, superintendents, foremen) into scoped features and talk to those users when it helps.
  • Ship small, frequent releases through CI/CD: automated tests, a staging environment, container deploys on Google Cloud.
  • Translate requirements into clean, tested, maintainable code with strong PR hygiene.
  • Use AI coding assistants every day and share the workflows with the team.
  • Work directly with product, other engineers, and occasionally customers. Bridge feature work and infra reliability. Review code thoughtfully and mentor where it helps.
attributes.benefits:
• Health: $150/month health and wellness stipend.
  • Engagement: B2B contract. 30-day mutual notice.
  • Fully remote. We are based in Denver, Colorado (MT, UTC-7). There must be significant overlap with US business hours.
  • Async-first. Docs, Loom, and well-written PRs are the norm. Meetings happen when they're the fastest path to clarity.
  • Small team, direct access. No middle layer between you and the people making decisions. Your work ships fast.
  • Latest tooling. We use the best AI tools available and expect you to do the same.
attributes.desirable:
• Prior startup experience where you were the only owner of an area.
  • A background in construction, the trades or field services.
  • Google Cloud, especially Cloud Run.
  • Multi-tenant SaaS.
  • Terraform and GitHub Actions.
  • Public work that shows how you build with AI: open source, write-ups or talks.
